verdict.rationale: Onboarding guidance is a fair axis for a project-management SaaS like Shortcut, but the evidence pack never documents a guided first-time workspace setup walkthrough. The closest items are a setup guide for connecting Codex CLI through the MCP server and a Jira/Trello/CSV import path. Both are adjacent integration and migration features, not a workspace onboarding walkthrough.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
